searchText: I created PR (https://github.com/ethereum/portal-network-specs/pull/407) to define new History Netowrk (old network was renamed to "Legacy History") Do we still use Portal Network Implementers Call? No. Do you think there is a need for a regular one? I think the plan is to have them periodically, when there is something to share and discuss. <@543900561460822016> , can you confirm? Created another PR (https://github.com/ethereum/portal-network-specs/pull/408) that adds `chain_id` to the ENR record (better support for devnets, testnets, l2-networks, etc)
